description: The fixed values a Core runner session answers questions with. Every value is a string in the encoding Web Apps sends Formplayer (formplayer api/json/JsonActionUtils::getAnswerData): a select takes the 1-based index of an option, a multi-select a space-separated list of indices, a geopoint 'lat lon altitude accuracy'; any other value is cast from its text by Core's AnswerDataFactory template for the question's control and data type. '@clock:today' and '@clock:now' stand for the run's clock (its date, and its instant), which the request fixes. A question takes its values from the first of: novaKinds, for the Nova kind the request names for its data path; controls, for the control Core reports; dataTypes, for the data type Core reports. Values are tried in order, at most three; an empty list leaves the question unanswered. A label (a trigger) is answered 'OK', which is what Web Apps submits for every label (cloudcare form_entry/web_form_session.js, accumulateAnswers). A text is first one with whitespace at both ends, which Core keeps as answered (Formplayer casts the text it is sent as it is, formplayer api/json/JsonActionUtils::getAnswerData), so a form that trims it, or one that does not, shows which; then plain text. A date or date-time is first the clock's own, which a constraint that an answer be recent and not in the future accepts, then one far in the past and one far in the future, for constraints that ask for either.
